Computes the mean of the low-precision input tensor's element along the provided axes.

The resulting tensor has the same rank as the input if keepdims equal 1. If keepdims equal 0,

with the exception that numpy default keepdims to False instead of True.

Input and Output scales and zero points are used to requantize the output in a new range.

This helps to improve accuracy as after ReduceMean operation the range of the output is expected to decrease.

citeturn94search6 [wordlim: 200] Published: 4 months ago; Crawled: 3 months ago; # [Web] DB-style detection model returns all-zero output on Apple M-series above ~2048px input — likely fp16 overflow in ReduceMean #29130 ... [Web] DB-style detection model returns all-zero output on Apple M-series above ~2048px input — likely fp16 overflow in ReduceMean#29130 ... This is consistent with the empirical "no error anywhere, the kernel just returns numerically wrong data" symptom: nothing is wrong from ORT's POV; the contents are corrupted by an out-of-band precision optimization in the Metal driver. ... ### ONNX Runtime Version or Commit ID

The model has ~10 squeeze-excitation blocks containing `ReduceMean` ops that sum across all spatial pixels of an intermediate tensor:

  * At 4000×3008 input, one such reduction sums ~752 k values per channel. An fp16 accumulator saturates to `+Inf` (fp16 max is 65 504), `Sigmoid` produces NaN/0, and the corruption propagates to all-zero output.
  * At 1920×1440, the sum is ~173 k — still over 65 504 but only by ~3×, which apparently stays finite.
  * At 960×720, the sum is ~43 k — comfortably under fp16 max.

This is consistent with the empirical "no error anywhere, the kernel just returns numerically wrong data" symptom: nothing is wrong from ORT's POV; the contents are corrupted by an out-of-band precision optimization in the Metal driver.

## Ruled out

  * Op-not-supported / fallback — zero error/warn lines in verbose log.
  * Graph optimizations — `graphOptimizationLevel: 'disabled'` reproduces identically.
  * Architecture depth — `PP-OCRv6_tiny_det` (much shallower) also fails at 4000 px and works at 960 px. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Highlights

### Performance

  * Enabled subgroup-matrix kernels on AMD GPUs (#32667).
  * Added an FP16 GEMV specialization for single-row decode projections (#33070).
  * Improved data movement in `Concat`, `Slice`, `Transpose`, and pooling, and vectorized NHWC depthwise convolution across channels (#32497, #32498).
  * Enabled local-window flash attention for `GroupQueryAttention` (#32462).
  * Optimized recurrent and chunked `GatedDeltaNet` execution (#32645, #33143).
  * Optimized sparse attention indexers and `SparsePagedAttention` softmax, and cached sparse-indexer QSA visibility and scores (#32613, #32656, #33017).

### Operator and Model Support

  * Added native `GatedDeltaNet` and `VarlenCausalConvWithState` kernels, including subsequent state-update-capacity support for `GatedDeltaNet` (#32510, #32477, #32767).
  * Added `SparseAttentionIndexer`, `DynamicSparseAttention`, and `SparsePagedAttention`, plus a packed sparse attention indexer for continuous batching (#32528, #32529, #32533, #32618).
  * Added fused CPU LinearAttention kernels for AVX-512, Arm64 NEON, and SVE, plus AVX2 LayerNorm/RMSNorm acceleration (#31674, #31973, #32178, #32356).
  * Added Go bindings for the ONNX Runtime C API and DeepSeek Engram contrib operators (#29615, #32268).

## Announcements & Compatibility

  * FP4 QMoE kernels are now enabled by default in CUDA builds, with Windows build support added in this release. Source builds can opt out with `-Donnxruntime_USE_FP4_QMOE=OFF` (#32096, #32163).
  * CUDA fpA-intB builds now default to a compact kernel set for FP16 activations, INT4/INT8 weights, scale-only quantization, and `block_size=32`. Set `-Donnxruntime_USE_FPA_INTB_GEMM_FULL=ON` when building from source to retain the full kernel set, including BF16, zero-point, bias, larger-block-size, and native Hopper variants (#32324).
  * CPU FP16 `Gemm` and `MatMul` execution is gated on hardware acceleration. CPU-assigned FP16 nodes without a matching kernel now fall back to FP32 (#32301, #32197).

  * Enabled local-window flash attention for `GroupQueryAttention` (#32462).
  * Optimized recurrent and chunked `GatedDeltaNet` execution (#32645, #33143).
  * Optimized sparse attention indexers and `SparsePagedAttention` softmax, and cached sparse-indexer QSA visibility and scores (#32613, #32656, #33017).

### Operator and Model Support

  * Added native `GatedDeltaNet` and `VarlenCausalConvWithState` kernels, including subsequent state-update-capacity support for `GatedDeltaNet` (#32510, #32477, #32767).
  * Added `SparseAttentionIndexer`, `DynamicSparseAttention`, and `SparsePagedAttention`, plus a packed sparse attention indexer for continuous batching (#32528, #32529, #32533, #32618).
